scientific_integrity: Kubiś–Shelah mixed sums, their torsion-free example, and OEIS A340335 are explicitly treated as prior work. The originality claim is restricted to the general mixed-sum orbit transform and the model-theoretic identification of A340335.
scientific_limitations: The transform is an immediate enumerative consequence of the mixed-sum definition plus homogeneity, so its value is the general formula and identification rather than a deep new structural theorem.
The search cannot rule out unindexed folklore or an equivalent observation under different terminology.
The general formula assumes finite labeled age profiles in each arity.
No independent audit has yet been performed.
title: Mixed-sum orbit transform and the A340335 profile of the Kubiś–Shelah torsion-free limit
